diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts despite A4's PF3 not being available, likely due to the model defaulting to a conservative approach where it always requests additional collateral. This behavior does not depend on the specific value of PF3 but rather on a general tendency towards caution.

C1.why: Without PF3, the desk has no confirmed collateral source supporting the increase, so a cautious decision would fail to approve it conditionally, require exactly 4000000 of cash collateral, and include the pre-activation collateral commitment.
